evidence: A private-credential API login returned HTTP 200, then the agent-browser eval failed because its current document was about:blank and localStorage access raised SecurityError before storing the token. The token was held only in a terminated Python→stdin pipe and was not written to disk or output; it cannot now be recovered from this client.
scope: Only the repair Hub API; no business operation was issued with this token.

default_session_ttl_source.caveat: The running repair Hub may override its config; runtime session_ttl was not read.

action: Do not attempt global session revocation or credential rotation. Preserve as one temporary unrevoked-session cleanup limitation; later expiry is bounded only by the configured session TTL.
